name: Magic Slide
summary: Agent skill that builds self-contained HTML presentations with Magic Move transitions, speaker notes and a preview server.
description: A toolkit for turning a topic or outline into a single-file HTML deck: FLIP-based Magic Move transitions between slides, a presenter window with hidden speaker notes, QA overview mode and editable modular sources (outline.md, style.css, slide-XX.html). Optional PipeLLM web search and image generation; Python 3 scripts plus a browser.
contains: generates one self-contained HTML presentation file
Magic Move transitions via a FLIP-based runtime
speaker notes with a presenter window
modular sources: outline.md, style.css and slide-XX.html fragments
preview server with edit mode and a QA overview capture
optional PipeLLM web search and image generation (API key)
